newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jardine confirm Cheong Kong bought shares.
newsitem.headline: Jardine confirm Cheong Kong bought shares.

text.p: Jardine Matheson Ltd and Hongkong Land Holdings Ltd confirmed on Tuesday that Cheong Kong Holdings Ltd and Hutchison Whampoa Ltd have bought some shares into their respective companies.

In a declaration to the Stock Exchange of Singapore, Jardine Matheson said it was notified on August 1 1997 that Cheong Kong and Hutchison, through their respective subsidiaries, were interested in buying 22.74 million shares representing 3.03 percent of the company.
Hongkong Land said in a similar declaration it received notice on the same day that Cheong Kong and Hutchison were interested in a total of 82.41 million shares, or 3.06 percent of the company.
Both Cheong Kong and Hutchinson are controlled by Hong Kong business tycoon Li Ka Shing.
Brokers in Singapore speculated that Li would buy more shares in the open market.
Hongkong Land shares jumped in heavy trading touching a new 1997 high of US$3.10 before easing to US$3.04, up 19 percent or 49 cents at 0234 GMT.
Jardine Matheson shares also rose US$1.15 to US$8.20 with more than 3.6 million traded.
